objective: Install the selected Windows SDK component using Visual Studio Installer supported syntax without the attempt-002 --wait option.
exactCommand: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\setup.exe" modify --installPath "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community" --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.Windows11SDK.26100 --quiet --norestart
exactPrimaryDiagnostic: Commands with --quiet or --passive should be run elevated from the beginning.
diagnosis: The corrected command was parsed and selected the intended component, but Visual Studio Installer rejected unattended execution because the initiating process was not elevated. No SDK package installation was performed.

repairDisposition.nextRepair: Use an installer-supported interactive/elevation-service path or a verifiably equivalent exact-SDK deployment path; do not bypass UAC or change security settings.
